machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

shape.schedule: first two steps of the canonical 40-step schedule

k_only_prototype.design: Keep the fused MPS QKV result in FP32, but have K RMSNorm plus RoPE store FP16 directly and let K/V preparation read that FP16 K.
k_only_prototype.result: rejected as indistinguishable from run-to-run noise

direct_fp16_qkv_prototype.design: Make fused MPS QKV write FP16 directly; read half Q and K in RMSNorm plus RoPE, retain FP32 normalized/rotated Q, store normalized/rotated K as FP16, and prepare K/V from half inputs.
direct_fp16_qkv_prototype.finite_validation: A one-step run checked every block and completed with finite outputs.
direct_fp16_qkv_prototype.oracle_validation: Not continued after the performance gate failed.

conclusion: The production FP32 fused-QKV output remains faster in measured wall time. Reduced transient bandwidth alone did not improve this MPSMatrix/MPSGraph pipeline.
